description: a new high score evicts the lowest and becomes the new cutoff
a score below the cutoff is rejected on a full board
a score is admitted freely while the board is under capacity
the first score on an empty board is the cutoff
a score that only ties the cutoff leaves the cutoff exactly where it was
an over-capacity board must be trimmed to cap: with 95 admitted the retained top 3 are 100/95/90, so the cutoff is 90 and not the 70 an untrimmed board would report
the trim happens even when the new score is rejected: the retained top 3 are 100/90/80
